sidebar: false

Use these private, browser-based tools to explore a skill, organize what you notice, or plan a next step. Your reflections stay on this device; no therapy answers are sent to a server.

You can also browse [DBT Skills](/learn/), [CBT Skills](/cbt-skills/), or [Mindfulness](/mindfulness/) directly.

## Interactive Tools {#interactive-tools}

### Find a Skill

::: {.skill-app-hub-grid}
::: {.skill-app-hub-card}
#### Skill Thermometer

Choose the state that feels closest right now and see skills that may fit.

[Open Skill Thermometer](/skill-finder/thermometer/)
:::
:::

### Emotions

::: {.skill-app-hub-grid}
::: {.skill-app-hub-card}
#### Emotion Explorer

Notice emotion words, body sensations, urges, and what happened next.

[Open Emotion Explorer](/skill-finder/emotions/)
:::

::: {.skill-app-hub-card}
#### Change an Emotion

Work through whether Check the Facts, Problem Solving, Opposite Action, or mindful observation may fit.

[Open Change an Emotion](/skill-finder/change-emotion/)
:::

::: {.skill-app-hub-card}
#### Pleasant Event Planner

Browse the curriculum's Pleasant Events List and make one idea easier to follow through on.

[Open Pleasant Event Planner](/skill-finder/pleasant-event/)
:::
:::

### Thoughts & Worry

::: {.skill-app-hub-grid}
::: {.skill-app-hub-card}
#### Worry Tree

Separate an actionable problem from a hypothetical worry and make a grounded plan.

[Open Worry Tree](/skill-finder/worry-tree/)
:::
:::

### Actions & Patterns

::: {.skill-app-hub-grid}
::: {.skill-app-hub-card}
#### Behaviour Chain Builder

Map vulnerabilities, the prompting event, chain links, consequences, and possible solutions.

[Open Behaviour Chain Builder](/skill-finder/behaviour-chain/)
:::

::: {.skill-app-hub-card}
#### Missing Links

Explore why an intended effective behaviour did not happen.

[Open Missing Links](/skill-finder/missing-links/)
:::

::: {.skill-app-hub-card}
#### Exposure Ladder

Arrange objectively safe practice steps from easier to harder.

[Open Exposure Ladder](/skill-finder/exposure/)
:::

::: {.skill-app-hub-card}
#### Behavioural Activation

Make one small action more specific and easier to start.

[Open Behavioural Activation](/skill-finder/behavioural-activation/)
:::
:::

### Relationships

::: {.skill-app-hub-grid}
::: {.skill-app-hub-card}
#### DEAR MAN Builder

Organize your own words into DEAR MAN, with optional GIVE and FAST prompts.

[Open DEAR MAN Builder](/skill-finder/dear-man/)
:::

::: {.skill-app-hub-card}
#### Ask or Say No Planner

Think through priorities, intensity, and troubleshooting without an automatic score.

[Open Ask or Say No Planner](/skill-finder/ask-or-say-no/)
:::
:::

### Goals & Values

::: {.skill-app-hub-grid}
::: {.skill-app-hub-card}
#### Values & Valued Action

Discover, sort, narrow, assess, and act on values using the workbook process.

[Open Values & Valued Action](/skill-finder/values/)
:::

::: {.skill-app-hub-card}
#### SMART Goal Builder

Turn a direction into a specific, measurable, achievable, relevant/realistic, time-oriented next step.

[Open SMART Goal Builder](/skill-finder/goal-builder/)
:::
:::
